name: SML Mahindra Ltd
title: SML Mahindra Ltd - 505192 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mahindra-controlled SML reports FY26 revenue +18% and PAT +31%, but Q4 PAT only +2% on ~1.3% margin headwind from commodity inflation; management guides price hikes of 2–3% to offset.

utilisation.quote: we have not lost any vehicle production till quarter four

capex.quote: When to put more Capex to launch the product is a cautious call we will take based on the market evolution

triggers.label: Price increase 2–3% from 15 April
triggers.quote: We have already taken a price increase starting from 15th of April, which for SML products, mostly it is around 2 percent and, in some cases, we have taken 3 percent price increase.

triggers.label: Q4 commodity hit ~1.3%, ~3.5% annualised
triggers.quote: on in quarter four, we saw around 1.3 percent increase, which at annualised level would be around 3.5 to 3.7 percent.

triggers.label: No deferment seen in school bus season
triggers.quote: thankfully we are not seeing any deferment or any slowdown.

triggers.label: FY31 market share aspiration 10–12%
triggers.quote: an FY31, we are looking at a market share aspiration of 10 to 12% with both brands combined presence, which right now is at 6

guidance.quote: an FY31, we are looking at a market share aspiration of 10 to 12% with both brands combined presence
around FY31, we are talking targeting 15,000 crores
we aspire to be top three in India's ILCV trucks and buses segment

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT only +2% vs revenue +16%
red_flags.quote: for quarter four, our revenue went up by 16%. Our PAT went up by 2%.

red_flags.label: Cargo market share dip in Q4
red_flags.quote: Market share, there is a minor blip

evasions.quote: at this moment we are working on long-term strategy as Amar said on various things just give us some more time
I would suggest just wait for some more time because launch is not in next quarter or so.
